# Lamp Care

A short guide to *keeping* a **brass** lamp bright. See [the manual](https://example.com/manual) for more.

## Daily tasks

1. Trim the wick.
2. Polish the glass with a soft cloth.
   Keep the cloth dry.
3. Top up the oil.

- [x] Checked the reservoir
- [ ] Ordered new wicks

> Clean glass gives the steadiest light.

```
lamp --trim --polish
```
